scope: Generated-only source-readiness checks. No accounts, market arrays, historical execution, downloads or publication.
risk_math_statement: The h090 risk controller is byte-identical to the reviewed calendar V2 component. Original _math, validate_weights, verify_originals and require_native_integration ASTs equal the prior independent risk review. H090 0.30 asset / 0.90 gross / 0.15 annual vol and original 0.30 / 0.60 / 0.10 arithmetic are unchanged.
calendar_AST_statement: Only two validation sites change. Removing the five-string JSON-list order guard and unwrapping the close predicate yields exact whole-module AST equality to calendar V2. No calendar, warmup, availability, return, covariance or sizing rule changed.
normalizations: Both manifest and source symbol_order must be a five-string JSON list before existing exact CORE5 order check. Null and malformed shape/type raise SourceReadinessError(EXACT_CORE5_SOURCE_ORDER_REQUIRED).

Existing positive finite close predicate is unchanged; only TypeError/OverflowError raised by that predicate are normalized to SourceReadinessError(POSITIVE_FINITE_SOURCE_CLOSE_REQUIRED), preserving the cause.

generated_tests.valid_calendar_parity: Exact array bytes, dtype and provenance match at daily, all six four-hour UTC points and midnight rollover.
generated_tests.baseline_dependency_note: AST/byte/parity checks read the cached sibling calendar and risk independent-review packages; all source bar fixtures are generated in the test.

source_authority_statement: Fixture hashes establish consistency only, not real-source certification or historical GO.

reviewed_generated_rerun.excluded_obsolete_test: One original independent test asserted TypeError for the three malformed-source cases; replaced by the new 11-test normalization suite.
